morning_judgment: August 29 keeps pressure on the same carrier-stress baseline: Russia/Ukraine violence moved from infrastructure pressure to mass-casualty storage and air-defense stress; the Iran lane remained an official U.S. sanctions-and-blockade posture rather than a clean settlement; the Venezuela oil story stayed live as an uncertain energy workaround; and Niger added a Sahel internal-security failure that sits outside the active Iran/Russia hooks but matters for Russia-linked security architecture. The Canada tariff-law item is retained as the outlier because it shows coercive economic authority being tested through domestic legal limits rather than through a foreign battlefield.
